events.title: Pound Rises Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: CAC 40 Climbs Higher As Technology, Luxury Stocks Move Up
events.description: The French stock market's benchmark index CAC 40 moved higher on Wednesday, tracking positive cues from other major markets in Europe, after Dutch semiconductor equipment maker ASML's upbeat earnings update.

events.title: DAX Climbs Higher Despite Acceleration In German WPI
events.description: Despite rising oil prices and an acceleration in wholesale price inflation, German stocks climbed higher on Wednesday as buoyant earnings update from Dutch semiconductor equipment maker ASML aided sentiment.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Amid RBA Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) did not hesitate to raise interest rates further this year, according to minutes from the September meeting.

events.title: ASML Q3 Profit Surges, Lifts FY26 Outlook; Warns About Supply Constraints
events.description: ASML Holding N.V. shares were trading higher in the morning trading in Amsterdam after the Dutch semiconductor equipment maker on Wednesday reported significantly higher profit in its third quarter with strong net sales growth. Further, the firm issued fourth quarter outlook and lifted fiscal 2026 view. The company also said it now expects that supply as currently planned for both 2027 and 2028...

events.title: Indian Shares End Modestly Lower After Strong Rally
events.description: Indian shares ended modestly lower on Wednesday after logging strong gains in the previous session, led by information technology stocks.

events.title: Gold Extends Losses Ahead Of US Inflation Data
events.description: Gold prices were moving lower on Wednesday, extending losses for a third consecutive session as investors assessed the prospect of another Federal Reserve interest-rate increase before the end of the year.

events.title: Singapore Unexpectedly Pauses Monetary Policy Tightening
events.description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore unexpectedly kept its monetary policy unchanged on Wednesday after two consecutive tightening. The MAS maintained the rate of appreciation of the policy band. Also, there will be no change to the width of the band and the level at which it is centered, the bank said in a statement. The bank was widely expected to tighten the policy.

events.title: Oil Pares Gains On Improved Hormuz Flows
events.description: Oil prices were little changed on Wednesday, giving up some early gains after data showed Saudi Arabia ramped up production in September despite continued disruption to oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: European Shares Rise As ASML Raises 2026 Sales Outlook
events.description: European stocks eked out modest gains on Wednesday as investors cheered strong results from ASML and awaited the release of U.S. CPI data later in the day for additional clues on the Federal Reserve's rate trajectory.

events.title: Asian Shares Slide Ahead Of US Inflation Data
events.description: Asian stocks ended mostly lower on Wednesday, even as pressure on tech stocks eased and dovish Fed remarks spurred expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve may not need to raise interest rates aggressively next year.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: China Exports Growth Beats Expectations
events.description: China exports growth accelerated more-than-expected in September on strong demand for hi-tech products, suggesting that overseas demand will help counteract the economic slowdown brought on by domestic demand and investment. Exports logged a sharp growth of 36.3 percent in September, bigger than the 25.0 percent rise in August, the General Administration of Customs reported Wednesday.
